headline:
Apps made
for one life.
sub: Free, open source and Agent Ready. Everything stays in files you own.
description: Glyph Labs: apps made for one life, yours. Free, open source and agent ready, and everything stays in files you own. Four layers: Glyph Bot, the environment your agents work in; Glyph Jot, what you know; Glyph Ibis, what the world knows; Glyph Rig, where your agents run. Plus Glyph Arena, Glyph Cast, Glyph Time and Glyph Native, the one install for all of them. By fru.dev.
